explanation: When the same fact is repeated across multiple rows, updating it can require many changes and create inconsistent values if some are missed. That is a modification anomaly.
prompt: A sales table stores customer email, customer phone, and order data in the same row. When a customer changes phone number, every past order row must be updated or the database becomes inconsistent. What kind of problem is this?
reviewConcept: Identify insert, update, and delete anomalies caused by poor structure.

source.title: Normalization and other Data Modeling Methods
